@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+# Copyright (c) Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '''local 192.168.1.37/24 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.1/32 dev lo scope host
+local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host
+local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host
+broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link
+local invalid dev lo scope host
+''', ''),
+        (0, '''local 2001:0DB8:0:0::1/64 dev lo scope host
+local ::1/128 dev lo scope host
+local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo scope host
+''', ''),
+    ]
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True)
+
+    result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[0][0][0] == [
+        '/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host']
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1][0][0] == [
+        '/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host']
+
+
+def test_get_locally_reachable_ips_command_failure(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo scope host', '')]
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True)
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip') == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Could not gather locally reachable ipv4 routes: unsupported')
+
+
+def test_populate_without_ip_command():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).populate() == {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once()
+
+
+def test_populate_includes_locally_reachable_ips(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    mocker.patch.object(network, 'get_default_interfaces', return_value=({}, {}))
+    mocker.patch.object(network, 'get_interfaces_info', return_value=({}, {
+        'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+    mocker.patch.object(network, 'get_locally_reachable_ips', return_value={
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']})
+
+    assert network.populate()['locally_reachable_ips'] == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector().fact_ids
